title: Imperator Furiosa: 15 gold breakout modules, individual stops and early live results
author: Livid_Parsnip_2816
selftext:
I’ve been developing Imperator Furiosa, a rule-based XAUUSD breakout EA for MT5. I’m its developer, and it is a commercial product. Here’s how the system is structured, together with a historical tester report and the current live account.



HOW THE ENTRIES WORK



Each module identifies confirmed swing highs and lows, then applies its own trend context and filters. When its conditions agree, it places a broker-side Buy Stop or Sell Stop. These are price-derived levels, not an order-book feed or direct measurements of institutional liquidity.



The 15 modules use different internal timeframes, pivot settings, filters and trading windows. Each position has its own stop-loss and take-profit configuration, with trailing stops used by selected modules. There is no DCA recovery or loss-driven martingale sizing.



THE SHARED DIRECTIONAL FILTER



The Citadel Gate evaluates conditions across several timeframes and updates its BUY, SELL or NEUTRAL permission hourly. New entries must agree with that permission. Pending orders expire at the hourly boundary, while open positions continue following their own module-specific exit rules.



THE HISTORICAL BACKTEST



The attached report is from the version 1.54 research run: January 2020 through June 2026, starting with $1,000 and 0.01 lot per module.



The MT5 report records 3,425 trades, $5,964.49 total net profit, a 2.19 profit factor and 9.60% maximum relative equity drawdown. These are the platform’s raw report figures. The separate audit after modeled fees gave $5,547.22 net profit and $176.81 maximum tickwise equity drawdown.



This run used genuine Darwinex tick timestamps and Bid prices with modified Ask prices fixed at Bid + $0.20, 1:500 leverage, and a separate modeled commission of 0.0025% per side. Known tick-coverage and tester-fallback limitations apply. It is a historical v1.54 test, not a fresh full-period test of the current release.



Later validation periods were outside the original training window, but their results were known when I selected the final portfolio. I would not describe that final selection as a completely untouched out-of-sample experiment.

https://i.redd.it/wrsrwyju7l0i1.png



WHAT THE LIVE ACCOUNT SHOWS



As of November 9, the public account shows +25.43% growth, 16.08% maximum equity drawdown, 57 trades, a 1.91 profit factor and a 75.4% win rate. October finished at +29.04%; November is currently -2.80%.



The live record includes a pullback, and its drawdown deserves attention alongside the return. It is a different account and execution environment from the historical test, so the percentages should not be treated as directly interchangeable.

https://i.redd.it/vgp6xbry7l0i1.jpeg



Fifteen modules still trade the same instrument. Different entry rules can produce different behaviour, but they do not turn gold exposure into diversification across independent markets.



I’m watching execution, overlapping positions and whether the modules behave as expected. The next useful evidence is a longer live record across more conditions.
